stem: Which sentence from the selection shows that Wagner was a positive influence on others?

options.label: F
options.text: Wagner would load about 2,000 pounds of coal onto a cart each day, earning 70 cents for a day's hard labor.

options.label: G
options.text: Wagner's love for the game would help him become one of the greatest baseball players of all time.

options.label: H
options.text: For much of that time, he was the best hitter in the National League.

options.label: J
options.text: Wagner tried to retire, but his coaches persuaded him to keep playing because they believed the team benefited from his leadership.
